4.text: OBSERVED FAILURE · DENSITY AND INTERNAL ENERGY
Conservation does not ensure positive Euler states
Why the attempted safeguards were insufficient

Flux corrections can make internal energy negative.
Normalized weights do not constrain Euler states.
SSPRK3 needs an admissible forward-Euler block.

Limit shared-face corrections toward an
admissible low-order flux, under its CFL.

11.text: WENO7: a defect and an empirical mitigation

100,000 stored normalized Euler stencils
ε = 10⁻⁶: 10 non-finite coefficient rows
ε = 10⁻⁴: 0 in the same forward test

Expanded β polynomials can cancel.
An instrumented near-flat row has β < 0.
Exact NaN operation remains unisolated.
Epsilon mitigation removed sampled NaNs; it did not prove order or Euler stability.
